zh: 园丁撒出种子时，先看种子落点。耙子紧接着从两侧飞来时，等它靠近再滑行穿过，落地种子还在时也要留意下一把耙子。
看到园丁带着环绕的叶片来回走，等他接近再滑过。半血后叶片变成两圈，种子和耙子也更密，留出滑行冷却时间。
园丁砸地后会放出贴地冲击波。不要在起手时就滑，等冲击波临近再穿过，结束后靠近用火柴打几下，然后退开。
en: Watch where the seeds will land. When rakes follow from the sides, wait for them to get close before sliding through. Watch for the next rake while seeds are still falling.

When the Groundskeeper walks back and forth with leaves around him, slide through as he gets close. Below half health the leaves form two rings and the seeds and rakes get denser. Leave time for the slide to recover.
After the ground slam, wait until the shockwave is close before sliding through. Step in for a few matchstick hits after the attack, then back away.

zh: 起始帐篷支路：从起始帐篷向上一间、向左一间，再向下一间进入竖井。沿气泡走到战斗房，清完敌人后打碎灵魂石像。
下层帐篷支路：在下层帐篷左上方找石像，用弹弓把火柴当落脚点跳上去。交付点就在这座帐篷左边，可以拿完顺路送回鸟巢。
上层帐篷支路：学会悬停后，从上层帐篷向左，经过一小段瞭望塔，从可下落的出口下去并打开门。石像在井口正上方的房间。
打碎石像后记得回下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢交付。交付 2、12、20 个灵魂时可领取饰物奖励。
en: Start tent branch: Go up one room, left one and down one into the shaft. Follow the bubbles to the combat room, clear the enemies and break the spirit statue.

Bottom tent branch: Look just above and left of the bottom tent. Use Slingshot to make a matchstick foothold and jump to the statue. The nest is just left of this tent, so you can return the spirit on the way back.

Top tent branch: After learning Hover, go left from the top tent through a short stretch of Lookout Tower. Take the downward exit and open the gate. The statue is in the room directly above the Well entrance.
After breaking the statues, return the spirits to the nest left of the bottom tent. Trinket rewards are available at 2, 12 and 20 returns.

zh: 生锈叉子：从猎人小屋中央帐篷向左一小段，站到左侧气泡下方，用弹弓把火柴射进右墙。踩气泡从上方绕过去，落到火柴上，再借它弹高拾取。
计时挑战与灵魂：学会悬停后，从中央帐篷往右三间，再向上三间到挑战石像。通过计时后进入奖励房，打碎石像救出灵魂。回夜之庭园的鸟巢交还。
en: Rusty Fork: Go a little left from the central Hunter’s Cabin tent. Stand below the bubble on the left and fire the matchstick into the right wall with Slingshot. Use the bubble to go around from above, drop onto the matchstick and bounce up to the pickup.

Time trial and spirit: After learning Hover, go right three rooms from the central tent, then up three to the trial statue. Finish the trial, enter the reward room and break the statue to free the spirit. Return it to the Night Garden nest.

zh: 发夹：从沼泽右侧帐篷往左一间、向下两间。按出现顺序踩气泡，完成后进入打开的门拿发夹。装备后，8 秒内不攻击，下一击伤害翻倍。
布片：从右侧帐篷往左三间，再向上、向右各一间。踩完依次出现的气泡，等门打开再进去拾取。装备后会小幅提高空中攻击伤害。
饰物槽：从左侧帐篷往上一间，打破左墙。向左用弹弓发射火柴，借火柴弹进气泡，够到饰物槽。
工坊代币：学会悬停后，从上方帐篷往左一间，借气泡弹到高处，再悬停到左侧墙边拾取。
左侧帐篷的灵魂：按右、下、左各走一间找计时挑战石像。完成挑战后走进打开的奖励房，打碎里面的灵魂石像。
上方帐篷的灵魂：学会悬停后，往左两间、往上两间，进入战斗房。清完敌人再打碎石像。两处灵魂都送回夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢。
en: Hair Pin: From the right-hand Bog tent, go left one room and down two. Bounce on the bubbles in the order they appear, then collect Hair Pin beyond the door. With it equipped, your next attack deals double damage after eight seconds without attacking.

Scrap of Fabric: From the right-hand tent, go left three rooms, then up one and right one. Finish the bubble sequence and collect it beyond the door. Equipping it slightly increases aerial attack damage.
Trinket slot: From the left-hand tent, go up one room and break the left wall. Fire the matchstick left with Slingshot, then bounce off it into a bubble to reach the slot.
Workshop Token: After learning Hover, go left one room from the upper tent. Bounce high on the bubbles, then hover toward the left wall for the token.
Left tent spirit: Go right, down and left, one room each, to the time trial statue. Finish the trial, enter the opened reward room and break the spirit statue inside.

Upper tent spirit: After learning Hover, go left two rooms and up two to the combat room. Defeat the enemies before breaking the statue. Return both spirits to the nest left of the lower Night Garden tent.

zh: 排水道灵魂：从中央帐篷向右进气流房，按住跳跃乘风升到顶部，再落到左侧平台，打碎灵魂石像。
融化蜡烛：从排水道中央帐篷一直向右，约五间后到有气流和尖刺的房间。用乘风通过，蜡烛在路线末端。装备后，每次治疗完成会获得短暂无敌。
鱼钩：从中央帐篷向左两间，再向上进计时挑战房。带上悬停和无限攀爬回访会更容易。通过计时后继续进开启的奖励房拾取，装备后低血量时会加快焰瓶补充。
隐藏饰物槽：回访前在帐篷装备玻璃眼，借它辨认隐藏入口。进入暗道后用御风和悬停抵达饰物槽，对照下方参考的槽位图文第 53 项定位。
回访顺序：拿到御风后，可从中央帐篷先走右侧的灵魂与蜡烛路线。之后带悬停回收隐藏饰物槽，拿到无限攀爬后再从帐篷走左侧，挑战鱼钩计时房。
en: Drains spirit: Go right from the central tent into the wind shaft. Hold jump to ride the updraft to the top, then land on the platform to the left and break the spirit statue.

Melted Candle: Go right from the central Drains tent until you reach the windy spike room, about five rooms away. Use Wind Ride to cross and collect the candle at the end. Equipping it briefly makes you invulnerable after healing.

Fish Hook: From the central tent, go left two rooms and up to the time trial. Hover and Endless Climb make the return easier. Finish the trial and enter the unlocked reward room to collect it. Equipping it speeds up Flaming Vessel refills at low health.

Hidden trinket slot: Equip Glass Eye at a tent before returning so you can spot the hidden entrance. Use Wind Ride and Hover inside to reach the slot. See entry 53 in the linked slot guide for the room location.

Suggested return order: Once you have Wind Ride, take the right branch from the central tent for the spirit and candle. Return with Hover for the hidden slot, then take the left branch to the Fish Hook trial once you have Endless Climb.

zh: 铃铛机关的饰物槽：学会攀爬和弹弓后回访。先对照槽位图文第 20 项找到射击点，攀上去把火柴射向远处的铃铛，再沿开启的通路拾取。
计时挑战的饰物槽：带弹弓和无限攀爬回访。起跑先射出火柴，跑过平台后借火柴向上弹跳。末段等移动刺球之间出现空隙再过。计时过关后，用无限攀爬走完奖励路线，拾取第 74 项。
墓谷灵魂：从墓谷帐篷往右三间，再往下一间。到房间上层后向左找暗墙，跳进去打碎灵魂石像。
破铃：从墓谷帐篷往左四间，无需额外能力。装备后，焰瓶投空时可补回一瓶。
裂纹弹珠：从帐篷向右两间，再向上、向左、向上各一间。到有临时挡板的机关房后攀到左上角，用弹弓敲铃，趁通路开放时过去拾取。
臼齿：东北角的竖井要从两侧开门。以帐篷为起点，一侧走上两间、右三间，另一侧走右三间、上两间。分别操作拉杆，再进入中间通道拾取。
en: Bell puzzle trinket slot: Return with Climb and Slingshot. Use illustrated slot entry 20 to find the firing position, climb up and shoot the matchstick at the distant bell, then follow the opened route to the slot.

Time trial trinket slot: Return with Slingshot and Endless Climb. Fire the matchstick at the start, sprint across the platforms and bounce off it to reach the upper path. Near the finish, wait for a gap between the moving spike balls. After clearing the trial, use Endless Climb on the reward route to reach slot entry 74.
Graven Valley spirit: From the tent, go right three rooms and down one. On the upper part of the room, jump left into the hidden wall and break the spirit statue.
Broken Bell: Go four rooms left from the Graven Valley tent. No extra ability is needed. When equipped, it restores a Flaming Vessel after a missed throw.

Cracked Marble: From the tent, go right twice, then up, left and up. In the room with temporary barriers, climb to the upper-left corner and use Slingshot to ring the bell. Cross while the route is open.

Molar Tooth: Open the northeastern shaft from both sides. From the tent, go up twice and right three times for one lever, then right three times and up twice for the other. Operate both levers and enter the central passage to collect it.

zh: 窄缝后的饰物槽：带上悬停、攀爬和弹弓，对照槽位图文第 35 项找窄缝。先把火柴射到缝隙另一侧，利用火柴落脚并向上弹跳，拿到槽位。
气泡房的灵魂：从瞭望塔下层帐篷往下再往右，进入气泡挑战房。用悬停调整落点，完成机关后打碎石像。
尖刺岔路的灵魂：先拿齐三枚飞行时长升级。从下层帐篷往左，向上三间到尖刺岔路，再沿右侧通道一直走到底，找到第二处灵魂石像。
同一处尖刺岔路往左可补拿工坊代币。右侧灵魂救出后，回夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢交付。
en: Trinket slot beyond the narrow gap: Bring Hover, Climb and Slingshot. Find the gap using illustrated slot entry 35, shoot the matchstick through it, then land on the matchstick and bounce up to the slot.
Bubble-room spirit: From the lower Lookout Tower tent, go down and right into the bubble challenge room. Use Hover to adjust your landings, then break the statue after clearing the puzzle.

Spike-fork spirit: Collect all three flight-duration upgrades first. Go left from the lower tent, climb three rooms to the spiked fork and follow the right-hand passage to its end for the second spirit statue.
Take the left branch at the same spike fork for a Workshop Token. After freeing the spirits, return them to the nest left of Night Garden’s lower tent.

zh: 从夜之庭园上层存档点向右，用弹弓借火柴越过尖刺、够到对面的墙。清完敌人后到右上角操作开关，走上方出口。下一处帐篷往左，沿路进入瞭望塔。
踩有羽毛的泡泡即可短暂飞行，头顶的小羽毛是提示。以塔内中央帐篷为基点，分别查帐篷左上、区域最左侧上方和右上三处飞行时长升级。
帐篷左上支路：第一次见到星歌者后，用弹弓把火柴射进右墙，借它跳到上方墙面并爬进顶层房间。向左跳上移动平台，敲转轮往左过关。清掉下一间的敌人，先别走下方出口，向左攀墙取第一枚升级。
远侧左上支路：拿到第一枚后，经下方出口操作回帐篷的捷径开关。向右落回上一间，再从左侧出口借羽毛泡泡飞过尖刺墙。清完左上方的敌人，从右墙攀到上方出口。向左进入下一段尖刺区，接力踩两颗羽毛泡泡，打开返程捷径后从上方离开。看到伊尔达后向右攀墙，清完敌人在房间顶部拿第二枚。
右上支路：从中央帐篷向右，借羽毛泡泡够到上方墙面，再向右清战斗房。敲转轮推动平台穿过移动尖刺柱，过关后先走右门。穿过下一段尖刺后往上，在三岔房用中央平台的羽毛泡泡飞到正上方出口。见到星歌者后向右攀墙，升级在顶部。
三次升级齐全后，回中央帐篷并借羽毛泡泡继续登高。尖刺段用飞行泡泡够到上方两处开关，打开右边出口。下一间敲转轮过移动平台，再攀墙操作开关。向右到第二处帐篷存档，继续向右挑战星歌者。
击败星歌者后向右进下一间，拾取用于开启女王城堡的金色羽毛。
en: Head right from the upper Night Garden save point. Use Slingshot and the matchstick to reach the wall across the spikes. Clear the enemies and hit the switch in the upper-right corner to open the exit above. Go left from the next tent to enter the tower.

Bounce on a feather bubble to fly temporarily. The small feather over your head shows the effect. Use the central tower tent as a base and look for the three duration upgrades above-left of the tent, high on the far left, and in the upper-right area.

Above-left branch: After first meeting Starsinger, use Slingshot on the right wall and bounce to the wall overhead. Climb into the upper room, jump onto the moving platform, and strike the wheel to ride left. Clear the next room and climb the wall on the left for the first upgrade before taking the lower exit.

Far-left branch: After the first upgrade, take the lower exit and open the shortcut to the tent. Drop back into the previous room on the right, then take its left exit and use the feather bubble to get past the spike wall. Clear the enemies above-left and climb the right wall to the upper exit. Go left and use two feather bubbles in succession to cross the next spike section. Open the shortcut and exit upward. From Ilda, climb the wall to the right, clear the enemies and collect the second upgrade at the top.

For the upper-right branch, leave the central tent to the right, use a feather bubble to reach the upper wall and continue right through the combat room. Strike the wheel to move the platform past the spike columns, then take the right door. Cross the next spikes, go up and use the central feather bubble in the three-exit room to reach the top exit. Climb to the right of Starsinger for the upgrade.

With all three upgrades, return to the central tent and use a feather bubble to resume the ascent. Use flight bubbles to hit both upper switches in the spike section and open the right exit. Cross the moving platform by striking its wheel, then climb to the next switch. Save at the second tent and head right to fight Starsinger.
After defeating Starsinger, enter the next room on the right and pick up the Golden Feather for Queen’s Castle.

zh: 以中央帐篷作为回访基点；飞行时长升级和金色羽毛是不同项目。
en: Use the central tent as a return point. Flight-duration upgrades and Golden Feathers are separate items.

zh: 摩天轮旁的灵魂：从秋日森林左侧帐篷向右两间，借摩天轮向上两间，再向左到计时挑战石像。通过计时后进奖励房，击碎灵魂石像。
蘑菇机关后的灵魂：从右侧帐篷往下，再往左。解开蘑菇房后进入下一间，用弹弓让火柴借蘑菇反弹，再用它作落脚点。带上攀爬和悬停，过机关后打碎石像。
两处救出的灵魂都交到夜之庭园下层帐篷左侧的鸟巢。
帐篷射靶：带弹弓参加小游戏。瞄准金色靶可拿饰物槽（槽位图文第 42 项），击中窄浅蓝靶可拿蓝色蝴蝶结。装备蝴蝶结后留一瓶油，受到致命伤时会自动消耗它来治疗。
玩偶头：带攀爬走石球机关支路，抢在石球之前爬到顶部，再向上击球点亮石柱，拾取饰物。装备后能增加攻击距离。
en: Ferris wheel spirit: Go right two rooms from the left Autumn Forest tent, use the Ferris wheel to go up two rooms, then head left to the time trial statue. Finish the trial, enter the reward room and break the spirit statue.

Mushroom puzzle spirit: From the right tent, go down and left. Solve the mushroom room and enter the next one. Use Slingshot to bounce the matchstick off the mushrooms and use it as a foothold. Bring Climb and Hover, then break the statue beyond the puzzle.
Return both freed spirits to the nest left of the lower Night Garden tent.

Tent target game: Bring Slingshot. Hit the gold target for a trinket slot (illustrated slot entry 42) and the narrow light-blue target for Blue Bow. Keep an oil vial in reserve while wearing the bow so it can spend the vial to heal you when you take a lethal hit.
Doll’s Head: Bring Climb to the orb puzzle branch. Reach the top ahead of the orb, then strike it upward to light the pillar and collect the trinket. It increases attack reach when equipped.

zh: 秋日森林入口需要两处开关。夜之庭园侧：从瞭望塔入口前的帐篷往西，清完途中战斗房，再操作开关。开关附近可顺路拿玻璃碎片饰物。
猎人小屋侧：回序章拿食物的房间，用弹弓和悬停够到上方出口。下一间往东到帐篷，再从帐篷向左走到两只移动铁笼处。
站在第一只铁笼上，把火柴从窄缝射向第二只铁笼，借它上到高处。从左边离开，下一间从最左侧的上方出口出去。继续往左操作第二处开关，门开后从上方出口进入秋日森林。
进森林后借蘑菇弹上高处，再向右越过尖刺坑，沿节庆布置继续前进。经过摩天轮时搭到顶部，从上方出口出去。解开第三处石球机关后经过节日帽商贩，继续向西到节庆帐篷。
节庆帐篷西侧封路时，从帐篷旁的下层通道绕行。遇到右侧路障就转左，解开第四处石球机关，继续向左并下砸破开木地板。清理下层敌人，经右侧出口绕到伊尔达烤橡果的篝火。
从篝火向左操作捷径开关，再攀到最上层，从背面打开节庆帐篷旁的路障。回帐篷存档后向西挑战森林之王。战后向右进下一间，与伊尔达交谈并拾取金色羽毛。
同一羽毛房间内，Ilda 右侧隐藏通道有故事书页；先确认攀爬路线。
en: The Autumn Forest gate has two switches. On the Night Garden side, go west from the tent before the Lookout Tower, clear the combat room and activate the switch. You can pick up Glass Shard nearby.

On the Hunter’s Cabin side, return to the room where you took food in the prologue. Use Slingshot and Hover to reach the upper exit. Go east in the next room to the tent, then head left to the two moving cages.

Stand on the first cage and fire the matchstick through the narrow gap into the second. Use it to climb up and exit left. In the next room, take the upper exit at the far left and continue left to the second switch. With the gate open, climb through the top exit into Autumn Forest.

Bounce up on the mushrooms, cross the spike pit to the right and follow the festival decorations. Ride the Ferris wheel up and take the top exit. After the third orb puzzle, pass the festive hat vendor and continue west to the festival tent.

If the route west of the festival tent is blocked, take the passage below it. Turn left at the right-hand barrier, solve the fourth orb puzzle and continue left to slam through the wooden floor. Clear the enemies below and take the right exit to loop around to Ilda’s acorn campfire.

Go left from the campfire to open the shortcut, then climb to the top and open the barrier beside the festival tent from the far side. Save and head west to the Forest King. After the fight, go into the room on the right, speak to Ilda and collect the Golden Feather.
A story page is hidden right of Ilda in the feather room; check the climbing route.

zh: 区域位于地图上方，呈橙色；森林之王场地是主要推进地标。
en: The orange region sits near the top of the map; the Forest King arena is a main landmark.

zh: 机关规则：同一轮让石球碰到全部石柱；落地、撞墙或离开画面会重置。
如果石球嵌在平台里面，先检查游戏是否已更新。Steam 10 月 2 日补丁修复了秋日森林的这项卡球问题。
双柱房：向左或右击球，让它在两根石柱间反弹。参考视频 00:00。
三柱房：把球向右打向地柱，趁球弹起跳过地柱，到右侧第一层平台。球下落时向左打向墙柱，留在平台等球反弹回来。球到顶柱正下方时向上打。参考视频 00:16。
第三处：站在石球右侧，把球向左打到斜蘑菇上。球反弹下落时，借房间中央的蘑菇跳起，在空中把球向右打，瞄准右侧弹性物的左上部。参考视频 00:34。
第四处：先把球向左打到斜蘑菇上。趁它弹向起点上方的顶棚蘑菇，跳上高台等球，再向左击球，让它撞上左侧较高的斜蘑菇。随后跑到石柱左侧，在左边顶棚蘑菇的左侧等球回来，把球打进石柱。参考视频 00:49。
玩偶头支路：先向左击球，立刻用攀爬抢到房间上方。等石球经过顶柱正下方，再向上击打，开门后拾取玩偶头。参考视频 01:12。
en: Hit every pillar in one attempt; floor, wall or off-screen contact resets the orb.
If the orb gets stuck inside a platform, check for updates. The October 2 Steam patch fixed this Autumn Forest issue.
Two-pillar room: send the orb sideways so it rebounds between both pillars. Reference video: 00:00.

Three-pillar room: hit the orb right toward the floor pillar, then jump over it onto the first ledge on the right. Hit the falling orb left toward the wall pillar and stay on the ledge. When it returns beneath the ceiling pillar, strike upward. Reference video: 00:16.

Third room: stand to the right of the orb and hit it left into the slanted mushroom. As the orb drops, bounce off the middle mushroom and strike right in midair, aiming at the upper-left of the right bumper. Reference video: 00:34.

Fourth room: hit left into the slanted mushroom. While the orb rebounds toward the ceiling mushroom above its start, climb onto the upper platform. Strike left again toward the higher slanted mushroom. Move to the left of the pillar, past the left ceiling mushroom, and hit the returning orb into the pillar. Reference video: 00:49.

Doll’s Head branch: hit the orb left, then climb to the upper part of the room before it arrives. Strike upward when it passes directly beneath the pillar, then go through the opened barrier to collect the trinket. Reference video: 01:12.

zh: 从码头船坞的 Barge 处拿到无限攀爬后，传送回沼泽。向左借气泡过水，留意对岸高台的工坊代币。继续往左，到尽头下落。经过像 Glimmer 姐妹的玩偶，再向前进入玩偶师之家。
和玩偶师对话后继续向左，从尽头下到存档帐篷。往下推进时，敲铃升起临时平台。到大锅前清掉刷出的敌人，再向右敲铃下落。
向房屋下层推进，完成玩偶师遭遇后检查西侧的 Magda 与墙壁弹射能力。
本区故事书页包含需要悬停、攀爬或弹射的回访位置。
en: After receiving Endless Climb from Barge at the shipyard, fast-travel to the Bog. Go left and bounce across the water. Look for a Workshop Token on the high platform on the far side, then continue left and drop at the end. Pass the doll resembling Glimmer’s sister to enter the Dollmaker’s House.

Speak to the Dollmaker, then go left and drop to the Save Tent. Ring the bells to raise temporary platforms as you descend. Clear the enemies by the cauldron, then head right and ring the bell to drop down.
Progress into the lower house; after the Dollmaker encounter, check west for Magda and Wall Sling.
Some story-page routes need Hover, Climb or Slingshot on a return visit.

zh: 从下层遭遇位置向西衔接新能力。
en: The new-ability route continues west of the lower encounter.

zh: 学会无限攀爬后，从沼泽帐篷往左，踩气泡过水。继续向左，在尽头下落，走到最左侧拾起长得像玛格达的玩偶，再往前进屋。
与玩偶师交谈后继续左行，下到第一处帐篷。从帐篷往下，敲铃展开临时平台。到坩埚房清掉出现的敌人，向右敲铃下落。
在右侧继续下落，敲铃移出平台，借平台攀到上方打第一根拉杆。继续向右打第二根，再完成右侧计时挑战。通关后直走领工坊代币，再折返计时装置旁往下。
找到第二处帐篷后，从旁边第一块平台下落，向右进埋葬墓穴打拉杆。折回玩偶师之家，从左侧继续下行，坐升降机到机关另一侧，用弹弓够到上方拉杆，打完继续往前进入首领战。
击败玩偶师之镜后向西救出玛格达，再去附近的能力巢穴完成教学，学会墙壁弹射。
en: With Endless Climb, go left from the Bog tent and cross the water on bubbles. Drop at the far left, pick up the doll resembling Magda and keep going into the house.
Speak to the Dollmaker, then go left and descend to the first tent. Drop below it and ring bells to extend temporary platforms. Clear the cauldron ambush, then go right and ring the bell to drop.

Drop on the right and ring the bell to move the platform into place. Climb it and strike the first lever above, then head right to the second lever and complete the time trial. Claim the Workshop Token ahead, then backtrack and drop beside the trial device.

At the second tent, drop from the first nearby platform and go right into Burial Vault to hit the lever. Backtrack into Dollmaker’s House, descend on the left and take the lift up on the opposite side. Use Slingshot to reach the upper lever, strike it and continue to the boss.
Defeat Dollmaker’s Mirror, go west to rescue Magda, and finish the nearby ability nest tutorial to learn Wall Sling.

zh: 参考路线使用墙壁弹射，从午夜雨境进入墓室。
向西推进至掘墓者；战后向左护送蜗牛到聚会处，继续领取金色羽毛。
en: The reference route enters from Midnight Drench using Wall Sling.
Continue west to Gravedigger, then escort the snail left to the party and Golden Feather.

zh: 掘墓者与聚会方向位于本区西侧。
en: The boss and party route are on the western side.

zh: 气泡路线的饰物槽：带弹弓回访，对照槽位图文第 22 项找到这条路线。先向最远的气泡射出火柴，再沿其余气泡依次弹跳过去，抵达槽位。
从干涸城堡回访的灵魂：从干涸城堡中央帐篷往左三间、往下两间，再往左两间。这条路线的石像归在午夜暴雨。
计时挑战的灵魂：从午夜暴雨上方帐篷向右两间，沿蛛雨旅店方向找到挑战石像。通过计时后进奖励房，击碎里面的灵魂石像。
蜘蛛网：从击败排水道女士后的通道进入午夜暴雨，向下一间、向右两间，到气泡机关房。先用弹弓把火柴向右射过气泡，只踩最后出现、位于饰物下方的气泡，借它弹上去。装备后可用弹弓发射焰瓶。
斜屋顶书页：从午夜暴雨上方帐篷稍向右再向上，继续向右两间到斜屋顶。越过屋顶后检查最右端的暗墙，进暗道沿墙向上拾取。
东侧书页：从干涸城堡中央帐篷向右找升柱，在柱子降下时借弹弓跳到柱顶，再从右侧竖井上去。下一间从右边进入午夜暴雨东侧，遇到第一处向上的通道就上去，借气泡和悬停过缺口。两张书页都属于《女巫的交易》，可用全书页图文第 9、10 项核对房间。
en: Bubble route trinket slot: Return with Slingshot and use illustrated slot entry 22 to locate the route. Fire the matchstick at the farthest bubble first, then bounce across the remaining bubbles in order to reach the slot.
Spirit from the castle approach: From the central Desiccated Castle tent, go left three rooms, down two and left two. The statue on this route is in Midnight Drench.
Time trial spirit: Go right two rooms from the upper Midnight Drench tent toward Webdrench Inn. Finish the trial, enter the reward room and break the spirit statue.

Spider’s Web: Enter Midnight Drench from the passage beyond the Lady of the Drains, then go down one room and right two rooms to the bubble puzzle. Fire the matchstick right through the bubbles, then bounce only on the final bubble beneath the trinket. Equipping it lets you launch Flaming Vessels with Slingshot.

Slanted rooftop page: Go slightly right and up from the upper Midnight Drench tent, then right two rooms to the slanted rooftops. Cross them and check the hidden wall at the far right. Wall-jump up inside the passage to collect the page.

Eastern page: Go right from the central Desiccated Castle tent to the moving pillar. Use Slingshot to reach its top while it is lowered, then take the right-hand shaft up. Leave the next room to the right for eastern Midnight Drench. Take the first passage up and cross using bubbles and Hover. Both pages belong to The Witch’s Bargain; compare room maps in illustrated entries 9 and 10.

zh: 七子神龛路线：学会悬停后，从墓谷往南或从干涸城堡东北侧回到午夜暴雨。找到中央有浮动气泡的房间，借气泡过到对岸，从右侧出去。
下一间借浮动气泡升到顶部，从右上出口到帐篷存档。继续往东，沿气泡逐级向上，敲顶部开关。从那里往左上走进入七子神龛战场。
击败七子神龛后向左拾取金色羽毛，再操作附近的开关，打开通往干涸城堡的捷径。
从蛛雨旅店逃出后也会回到午夜暴雨。
墓谷救援后的路线：和艾格伯特交谈后，从他身后的地板下落，进入午夜暴雨另一侧。先去正下方房间，再从左下出口往下落。
沿路向左进入干涸城堡，接着落到下一层。继续往左找到东门开关，操作后到入口帐篷存档。
en: Shrine route: After learning Hover, return to Midnight Drench from southern Graven Valley or northeastern Desiccated Castle. Find the room with a floating bubble in the middle, bounce across and take the right exit.

Ride the bubbles to the top of the next room and take the upper-right exit to the save tent. Continue east and climb the bubbles to strike the switch at the top. From there, go up and left to the Shrine of the Seven Sons arena.
After defeating the Shrine, go left to pick up the Golden Feather and use the nearby switch to open a shortcut to Desiccated Castle.
Escaping the Innkeeper returns you to Midnight Drench.
After the Graven Valley rescue, drop through the floor beyond Egbert to reach the far side of Midnight Drench. Enter the room directly below, then descend again through its lower-left exit.
Head left into Desiccated Castle and drop to the lower room. Continue left to the east gate switch, activate it, then save at the entrance tent.

zh: 地图上的深蓝色区域；可用七子神龛场地定位金色羽毛路线。
en: The dark-blue region; use the Shrine arena to orient the feather route.

zh: 追逐主要向左推进。依次处理可破坏障碍、落地砸开的地板和需要敲钟切换的平台。
留意蛛网球的借力点；按画面中的交互提示操作。
最后长距离滑出后回到午夜雨境，并取得金色羽毛。
en: The chase runs mainly left. Handle breakable barriers, smashable floors and bell-switched platforms.
Watch for web-ball launch points and follow the on-screen interaction prompt.
The final long slide exits into Midnight Drench and awards a Golden Feather.

zh: 紫色区域；底部通道与向左追逐出口是主要地标。
en: A purple region; the lower passage and leftward chase exit are key landmarks.

zh: 集齐七根金色羽毛后，从沼泽进入城堡。
寻找 Ilda 的三对兄弟姐妹；其中一对由银色玩偶守护。
完成女王战后仍可回访补收集。
en: With seven Golden Feathers, enter the castle from the Bog.
Find Ilda's three sibling pairs; Silver Doll guards one pair.
Exploration and collection remain available after the Queen fight.

zh: 皇家紫色区域；先按兄弟姐妹任务推进到女王。
en: The royal-purple region; follow the sibling objective towards the Queen.

zh: 星歌者沿场地横跑时会放出飞羽，先看飞羽走向。卷成羽轮冲过来时，等它接近再滑行穿过，躲开后回身反击。
附身头颅后，红色大弹会分裂成小弹。先横移避开大弹，再看小弹散开的方向，留出落脚空间。看到头颅起跳砸地，跳过沿地面传播的冲击波。
头颅变红后，招式衔接更紧。每轮先躲完再还击，距离较远时趁收招投焰瓶。击败后向右进下一间拿金色羽毛。
en: Watch the feathers as Starsinger runs across the arena. When the feather wheel rushes toward you, wait until it is close, slide through and turn back to counter.

Once Starsinger possesses the head, the large red shots split into smaller ones. Move sideways away from the main shot, then watch where the smaller shots spread. Jump over the ground shockwave when the head leaps and slams down.

When the head turns red, attacks come closer together. Finish dodging before countering. Use a Flaming Vessel from a distance during recovery. Go right to the next room for the Golden Feather after winning.

zh: lookout-tower
en: lookout-tower

zh: 开场地面长出尖刺时，借两侧蘑菇弹起，悬停穿过移动尖刺之间的空隙。先看清落脚点，再靠近中央的森林之王输出。
石块砸下时先避开落点，再跳到石块上躲开地面尖刺。叶片横向飞来时，从石块上起跳越过。地刺退去、首领开始落黑色泪滴时，沿平台滑行避开落点。
叶片从下方升起时，借侧墙攀高，再悬停调整位置。后段只剩一面墙可以借力，看到叶片升起就先往那侧靠。战后向右进下一间，找伊尔达并拾取金色羽毛。
en: When floor spikes appear at the start, bounce on the mushrooms and use Hover to cross between the moving spikes. Check your landing before moving in to attack the Forest King in the center.

Avoid the falling rock, then jump onto it to stay clear of floor spikes. Jump from the rock over leaves moving across the arena. When floor spikes recede and black tears start falling, slide along the platform to dodge their landing spots.

When leaves rise from below, climb a side wall and use Hover to adjust. Late in the fight only one wall remains, so move toward it as the leaves rise. After winning, go right to speak to Ilda and pick up the Golden Feather.

zh: autumn-forest
en: autumn-forest

zh: 弹跳电球会追踪你，触地时还会放出冲击波。保持横向移动，看到球落地再跳过沿地面扩散的电波。
地面出现粉色光柱时，先离开标记处。骨臂会从那里伸出并横扫，同时留意下落的小电球，等落点空出来再靠近。
看到神龛蓄力准备放中央光束时，先往侧边移。电流会沿地面和墙面传播，可借侧墙起跳，再用悬停等电流过去。
场内铺出电线时，先移到线与线之间的空隙，等放电结束再回去打。战后向左取金色羽毛。
en: The bouncing orb tracks you and sends out a shockwave when it touches down. Keep moving sideways and jump over the wave as the orb lands.
Leave pink warning columns before bone arms emerge and sweep across the floor. Watch where the small electric orbs fall and move in once the landing area clears.
When the Shrine charges its central beam, move to the side. Electricity travels along the floor and walls. Use a wall jump and Hover to stay clear until it passes.
When wires appear across the arena, move into a gap between them and wait for the discharge before attacking again. Go left for the Golden Feather after the fight.

zh: midnight-drench
en: midnight-drench

zh: 在埋葬墓穴第二处帐篷休整，从帐篷向左进入掘墓人战场。
看到铲子砸地，先看碎骨飞向哪里，再选落脚点。若地面冒出一排骨刺，跳起悬停，等尖刺消退再落地。骨刺持续较久，和首领隔得远时优先悬停，避免滑行结束后仍停在骨刺里。
骨球会向五个方向散开，再沿场地飞回。跳过第一轮后，先留出落脚空间看回程，再决定跳还是滑。等掘墓人收招、骨球也离开身边后，贴近用火柴打几下就退开。
如果常在回旋骨球时掉血，可在战前帐篷装备蓝色蝴蝶结，并留一瓶油。受到致命伤时，它会消耗油瓶自动治疗。蓝色蝴蝶结可从秋日森林射靶小游戏的窄浅蓝靶取得。
胜利后继续向左到聚会屋，把 Irma 送到 Squinton 的生日聚会，完成剧情后领取金色羽毛。
en: Rest at the second Burial Vault tent and go left to enter the Gravedigger arena.

When the shovel hits the floor, watch where the loose bones fly before choosing a landing spot. If a line of spikes rises, jump and Hover until it clears. The spikes linger, so use Hover at a distance to avoid ending a slide inside them.

Bone balls spread in five directions and then return. After dodging the outgoing volley, leave room to land and watch the return path before jumping or sliding again. Move in for a short matchstick combo once the Gravedigger recovers and the bone balls have cleared your position.

If returning bone balls keep catching you, equip Blue Bow at the tent and keep an oil vial in reserve. It spends the vial to heal you when you would otherwise die. Hit the narrow light-blue target in the Autumn Forest minigame to earn it.
After victory, continue left to the party house. Escort Irma to Squinton’s birthday party and finish the scene to collect the Golden Feather.

zh: burial-vault
en: burial-vault

zh: 多镜下落时找眼睛朝上的镜子，移动到其下方安全区。
镜子贴地往返时会向外射出碎片。用无限攀爬拉开高度，但碎片扫向你所在的墙时要换位。碎片绕镜子旋转时，等外圈出现空隙再跳过去，靠近后用火柴反击。
约半血时屏幕分成两半。右边的本体按正常方向移动，左边的倒影反向移动。镜子每次只在一侧出现，先确认它在哪边。需要向右避开左屏的危险时，按左，让左边的倒影往右走。
两侧同时落下能量球时，先盯落球更密的一侧。躲开当前一轮后再看另一边的位置，等有空档再靠近镜子出手。
击败镜子后往西找 Magda，完成救援并核对成就。进入能力巢穴完成教学，取得墙壁弹射。
en: During falling mirrors, shelter beneath the mirror with the upward-looking eye.

The mirror fires shards as it skims across the floor. Use Endless Climb to gain height and move off the wall if shards sweep toward it. When shards orbit the mirror, jump through a gap in the outer ring and use the matchstick to counter up close.

At about half health the screen splits. Glimmer on the right moves normally, and the reflection on the left moves in the opposite direction. Check which half the mirror appears in. If the reflection needs to dodge right, press left.
When energy balls fall on both sides, watch the denser pattern first. Check the other side once the volley passes, then move in to attack the mirror during an opening.
After the fight, head west to rescue Magda and check for the achievement. Complete the ability nest tutorial to learn Wall Sling.

zh: dollmakers-house
en: dollmakers-house

zh: 共 23 页，分为《女巫的交易》9 页、《玩偶师》8 页、《瞭望塔》6 页。
菜单 Pages 分页可核对分组；女王战后可以继续补齐。
《女巫的交易》（9 页）：按书内顺序查夜之庭园（图文 1）、干涸城堡（5）、墓谷（6）、干涸城堡（8）、午夜暴雨（9、10）、猎人小屋（20）、干涸城堡（21）、女王城堡（23）。第 4 页要等干涸城堡的躲避女王段落结束后回收。
《玩偶师》（8 页）：依次查猎人小屋（图文 2）、沼泽（3）、秋日森林（13）、沼泽（15）、玩偶师之家（16、17）、埋葬墓穴（18）、玩偶师之家（19）。秋日森林那页在森林之王战后，进金羽毛房间查伊尔达右侧暗道。
《瞭望塔》（6 页）：依次查夜之庭园（图文 4）、墓谷（7）、瞭望塔（11、12）、深海（14）、沼泽（22）。深海那页可在解锁潜水载具、进入深海后拾取。
《女巫的交易》第 5 页（图文 9）：从午夜暴雨上方帐篷稍向右再向上，然后往右两间到斜屋顶。越过屋顶后，从最右端的暗墙进入，沿墙向上拾取。
《女巫的交易》第 6 页（图文 10）：从干涸城堡中央帐篷向右找升柱。等柱子降下来，用弹弓跳上柱顶，经右侧竖井向上。下一间向右进入午夜暴雨东侧，走第一处向上的通道，借气泡和悬停越过缺口。
《玩偶师》第 5、6、8 页（图文 16、17、19）：都在玩偶师之家。第 5 页用悬停和攀爬。第 6 页带弹弓、无限攀爬和悬停，从右侧平台射出火柴后悬停过去。第 8 页可按房间图直接回收。
《女巫的交易》第 9 页（图文 23）：从女王城堡右侧帐篷向左两间，再向下一间、向左一间。回访时带无限攀爬与悬停。
《女巫的交易》第 4 页（图文 8）：完成干涸城堡的躲避女王段落后，带弹弓、攀爬回访。按图文第 8 项的截图找房间。
《女巫的交易》第 8 页（图文 21）：在干涸城堡先用弹弓触发地板机关，再沿右侧升柱上升。等升柱与左侧横伸的尖刺柱齐平，把火柴作为中途落脚点，借它跳到对面。
《瞭望塔》第 5 页（图文 14）：从码头帐篷往左登上潜水载具，沿第二道闸门路线潜到底，再从另一侧上浮。去第二根拉杆的途中检查书页。
《玩偶师》第 3 页（图文 13）：击败森林之王后进金色羽毛房，在伊尔达右侧找暗道。
《玩偶师》第 1 页（图文 2）：在猎人小屋找到会上升的尖刺方块，从上方站到方块顶面，随它升到暗道里的书页。
《女巫的交易》第 3 页（图文 6）：带攀爬和弹弓回墓谷。对照图文标出的射击站位，用弹弓把火柴射向铃铛，再去拿书页。
《玩偶师》第 4 页（图文 15）：带弹弓和攀爬回沼泽。在帐篷左侧的房间站上最左边最高的台阶，把火柴射向右侧书页所在的墙。
《玩偶师》第 7 页（图文 18）：在埋葬墓穴对照房间图找暗道。进暗道后，拾取书页无需额外能力。
《瞭望塔》第 6 页（图文 22）：带无限攀爬回沼泽，从第一处帐篷往右，检查通往排水道的长隧道。
括号内是参考图文的全局编号，按编号可以找到对应房间截图。
en: 23 pages form three books: The Witch's Bargain (9), The Dollmaker (8) and The Lookout Tower (6).
Check the Pages menu by book; collection remains possible after the Queen fight.

The Witch’s Bargain (9 pages), in book order: Night Garden (walkthrough 1), Desiccated Castle (5), Graven Valley (6), Desiccated Castle (8), Midnight Drench (9–10), Hunter’s Cabin (20), Desiccated Castle (21), Queen’s Castle (23). Page 4 is available after the Queen evasion sequence.

The Dollmaker (8 pages): Hunter’s Cabin (walkthrough 2), the Bog (3), Autumn Forest (13), the Bog (15), Dollmaker’s House (16–17), Burial Vault (18), Dollmaker’s House (19). After the Forest King, check the hidden passage to Ilda’s right in the Golden Feather room.

The Lookout Tower (6 pages): Night Garden (walkthrough 4), Graven Valley (7), Lookout Tower (11–12), the Deep (14), the Bog (22). The Deep page is available once you unlock the submarine and enter the region.

The Witch’s Bargain, page 5 (entry 9): From the upper Midnight Drench tent, go slightly right and up, then go right two rooms to the slanted rooftops. Cross them, enter the hidden wall at the far right and climb to the page.

The Witch’s Bargain, page 6 (entry 10): Head right from the central Desiccated Castle tent to the moving pillar. Use Slingshot to reach the top while the pillar is lowered, then take the right-hand shaft up. Exit right into eastern Midnight Drench, take the first passage up, and cross the gap with bubbles and Hover.

The Dollmaker, pages 5, 6 and 8 (entries 16, 17 and 19): All three are in the Dollmaker’s House. Use Hover and Climb for page 5. Bring Slingshot, Endless Climb and Hover for page 6, and fire the matchstick from the right platform before hovering across. Use the room map to find page 8.
The Witch’s Bargain, page 9 (entry 23): From the right-hand Queen’s Castle tent, go left two rooms, down one and left one. Bring Endless Climb and Hover.
The Witch’s Bargain, page 4 (entry 8): Finish evading the Queen in Desiccated Castle, then return with Slingshot and Climb. Use the room screenshot in entry 8 to locate the page.

The Witch’s Bargain, page 8 (entry 21): In Desiccated Castle, trigger the floor mechanism with Slingshot and ride the right-hand pillar up. When it lines up with the spikes jutting out from the left, use the matchstick as a foothold to jump across.

The Lookout Tower, page 5 (entry 14): Board the submersible left of the Docks tent and follow the second gate route to the bottom, then surface on the far side. Look for the page on the way to the second lever.
The Dollmaker, page 3 (entry 13): After defeating the Forest King, enter the Golden Feather room and check the hidden passage to Ilda’s right.
The Dollmaker, page 1 (entry 2): In Hunter’s Cabin, get onto the top of the moving spike block and ride it up to the hidden passage with the page.
The Witch’s Bargain, page 3 (entry 6): Bring Climb and Slingshot to Graven Valley. Use the illustrated firing position to shoot the matchstick at the bell, then collect the page.

The Dollmaker, page 4 (entry 15): Bring Slingshot and Climb to the Bog. In the room left of the tent, stand on the highest step at the left and fire the matchstick toward the wall with the page on the right.
The Dollmaker, page 7 (entry 18): Use the Burial Vault room map to locate the hidden passage. Once inside, picking up the page takes no extra ability.
The Lookout Tower, page 6 (entry 22): Return to the Bog with Endless Climb. Go right from the first tent and check the long tunnel leading to the Drains.
Numbers in parentheses match the illustrated walkthrough’s global order. Use them to find the room screenshots.

zh: 攻击鸟形雕像释放灵魂，带回夜之庭园的灵魂标记处。
地图标记分别显示发现与归还数量；完成 20 次归还对应 Full Flock。
en: Strike bird statues to release spirits and return them at the Night Garden spirit marker.
The marker distinguishes found and returned counts; 20 returns complete Full Flock.

zh: 接任务：救出针儿和刺儿后，回码头船坞找 Barge 学无限攀爬。到码头第一个帐篷的上一层，找第二处帐篷旁可进入的旧靴子。进靴子和低语者谈话拿金门钥匙，之后按地图上的金锁标记找四扇门。
腿（墓谷）：从帐篷往右，借弹弓向上，到顶层打开金门。敲吊铃放出临时平台，趁平台收回前到上方敲拉杆。继续上攀并清掉守路敌人，从上层往左。再用弹弓远距离敲铃，过第二组临时平台，在对面拿腿。
手臂（干涸城堡）：从帐篷往左，经过摆动平台和移动气泡，打开金门。用弹弓打齿轮，乘升起的平台过到对面，从左侧下落。沿路清怪，到尽头再下落，向左敲拉杆。折回下落后往右穿过粉色尖刺区，用悬停或弹弓上到高处，击败持蜡烛的敌人后向前拾取。
躯干（排水道）：从排水道帐篷往东找金门，门后还有一处帐篷。存档后往右，借气流和悬停穿过带刺墙面。后面几段也要在气流中调整高度，沿同一条通道走到尽头拾取。
头（沼泽）：金门在女王城堡入口西侧。过尖刺后击败两名敌人，从左上出口离开。借气泡升到顶，再向右到下一间操作开关，从上方越过挡板。继续爬高，避开尖刺缓慢下落，走左门。向左走时可以先下去开回程捷径，再返回上方平台，借气泡到顶部出口，进入房间拿头部。
交付：四件齐全后跟地图的新目标回码头旧靴子，与低语者交谈并拼好拾荒者。等交付剧情结束，确认金色羽毛入手并解锁成就，再离开。
旧版本如果直接跳过了拼装剧情，先更新游戏。Steam 10 月 2 日补丁移除了会跳过这段剧情的调试逻辑。
en: Start: After rescuing Thimble and Thistle, learn Endless Climb from Barge at the Docks shipyard. Go one level above the first Docks tent and enter the old boot beside the second tent. Speak to Whisper for the Golden Gate Key, then follow the four gold padlock markers on the map.

Legs (Graven Valley): Head right from the tent and use Slingshot to climb to the Golden Gate. Ring the hanging bell beyond it and cross the temporary platforms to strike the upper lever before they retract. Climb past the enemies and head left from the upper platform. Use Slingshot to ring the second bell and cross the next set of temporary platforms to the legs.

Arms (Desiccated Castle): Head left from the tent, cross the swinging platforms and moving bubbles, and open the Golden Gate. Hit the gear with Slingshot and ride the rising platform across. Drop on the left, clear the enemies, then drop again at the end and go left to the lever. Backtrack and drop to the right through the pink spikes. Use Hover or Slingshot to reach the upper platform, defeat the candle enemy and collect the arms ahead.

Torso (The Drains): Find the Golden Gate east of the Drains tent. Save at the tent just beyond the gate, then go right and use the air currents and Hover to cross the spike walls. Adjust your height in the currents along the next sections and follow the passage to the pickup.

Head (The Bog): Open the Golden Gate west of the Queen’s Castle entrance. Cross the spikes, defeat the two enemies and take the upper-left exit. Bounce up on the bubbles, go right to the next room and hit the switch to pass above the barrier. Climb high, then descend carefully past the spikes and exit left. The downward branch opens a shortcut. Return to the upper platform and use the bubbles to reach the top exit and the head.

Hand-in: Once you have all four parts, follow the new map objective back to the old boot at the Docks. Speak to Whisper and reassemble Looter. Before leaving, finish the scene and check for the Golden Feather and achievement.
If the reassembly scene was skipped on an older build, update the game. The October 2 Steam patch removed leftover debug logic that could skip this scene.

zh: 先学御风：从中央帐篷向右穿过有风和尖刺的房间，在右侧出口前沿平台下落。到下层底部后向右，清掉战斗房的四个敌人。继续向右，下一间再下落后右转，找到能力蛋并完成教学。
右上零件：从有金门的房间向上找气流，用御风进入上层房间，再爬到顶端拾取。
左下零件：连续向左穿过风区与尖刺，借气泡越过长缺口。进入左边下一间后，把火柴插进墙里，借它弹跳上去拿零件。
中央帐篷上方：跳过管道，上到点着蜡烛的风道，御风升到上一间，零件在右侧。再往上一层可开通往夜之庭园的捷径。
集齐三件后回中央帐篷旁的升降机，操作拉杆下行，进入排水道女士的战斗。还差一件时，按右上金门、左下气泡、帐篷上方蜡烛三处地标逐一回查。
en: Learn Wind Ride first: Head right from the central tent through the windy spike room. Drop down from the platforms before the right exit, then turn right at the bottom and clear the four enemies. Continue right, drop in the next room and go right again for the Ability Egg and tutorial.
Upper-right part: Head up from the Golden Gate room and ride the current into the room above. Continue to the top for the part.
Lower-left part: Head left past wind and spikes, using the bubble to cross. In the next room, plant the matchstick in the wall and bounce up to the part.
Above the central tent: Jump over the pipe to the candle-lit wind shaft. Ride the current into the next room and collect the part on the right. Continue upward to open a shortcut into Night Garden.

Bring all three parts to the lift beside the central tent and pull the lever to descend to the Lady of the Drains fight. If a part is missing, check the three landmarks: the upper-right Golden Gate, the lower-left bubble and the candles above the tent.

zh: 女王寝室西门需要集齐 32 件饰物，其中一件是把 20 个灵魂送回夜之庭园鸟巢的奖励。开门后拾取巢中的能力蛋，完成指引学会腾空，再飞到巢上方取得神秘标记。
玩偶师之家：到最高一层通道的中央房间，腾空进入上方隐藏区，走到尽头拾取。
夜之庭园：从通往沼泽的最西侧房间腾空，清理隐藏区的战斗房，再沿上方通道取碎片。
秋日森林：在计时挑战房西侧的房间腾空，完成隐藏区的平台跳跃，在终点拾取。
码头：从 Whisper 小屋旁的帐篷往东到桥上，腾空进入隐藏区。登上顶部平台再跳下，下落途中收齐 100 个闪光物。
码头挑战技巧：闪光物会从屏幕下方往上移动。尽量待在画面偏下的位置，左右跟着下一组移动；漏过一个时还有空间向上补捡。若确定漏捡，可按画面左下角提示重置，也可以先走到终点看完排列再重试。
干涸城堡：到东南角的帐篷，站在帐篷右侧鸟巢处腾空，爬到隐藏塔顶取碎片。五枚齐全后，回夜之庭园的灵魂鸟巢触发真结局。
en: The western door in the Queen’s chambers requires all 32 trinkets. One is the reward for returning 20 spirits to the Night Garden nest. Beyond the door, complete the Ability Egg tutorial to learn Soar, then fly above the nest to find Mysterious Markings.
Dollmaker’s House: Soar from the middle room on the top corridor and follow the hidden passage to the end.
Night Garden: Soar from the far-west room connecting to the Bog. Clear the combat room and follow the upper path.
Autumn Forest: Soar in the room west of the time trial. Clear the platforming route to the pickup.
The Docks: Use Soar from the bridge east of the tent by Whisper’s hut. Climb the hidden area and leap from the top platform to collect 100 lights on the way down.

Docks challenge tips: The lights rise from the bottom of the screen. Stay low and move sideways toward the next group, leaving room to move up for a missed light. Follow the lower-left reset prompt if you miss one, or finish the attempt to see the remaining patterns before retrying.

Desiccated Castle: Soar from the nest to the right of the southeastern tent and climb the hidden tower. Once all five fragments are collected, return to the Night Garden spirit nest for the true ending.

zh: 金色羽毛共七根，用于开放女王城堡入口。
下水道：修好升降机并下到底层，击败下水道夫人后，到后续房间拾取羽毛。
午夜暴雨：击败七子神龛后往西走，拾取羽毛。
拾荒者零件：收齐四块零件，回去交给低语者领取羽毛。
瞭望塔：登上最高处，击败星歌者领取羽毛。
秋日森林：击败东北侧的森林之王，继续向东到下一间拾取。
埋葬墓穴：击败掘墓人后，到 Squinton 的住处完成聚会，再领取羽毛。
蛛网旅店：完成区域末尾的追逐，在终点拾取羽毛。
瞭望塔的三次飞行时长升级不是金色羽毛。
en: Seven Golden Feathers open the Queen's Castle entrance.
The Drains: Repair the elevator and descend. Defeat the Lady of the Drains, then collect the feather in the room beyond.
Midnight Drench: Defeat Shrine of the Seven Sons, then head west for the feather.
Looter Parts: Collect all four parts and return to Whisper for the feather.
Lookout Tower: Reach the top and defeat Starsinger for the feather.
Autumn Forest: Defeat the Forest King in the northeast, then go east to collect the feather.
Burial Vault: Defeat Gravedigger, then finish the party at Squinton’s place to receive the feather.
Webdrench Inn: Finish the chase at the end of the area and pick up the feather at the finish.
The tower's three flight-duration upgrades are separate items.

en: Acquire Wind Ride, find the three Drains parts and return to the central-tent elevator.

zh: 从午夜暴雨右端下落后往左，用弹弓和攀爬越过平台，再向下进入埋葬墓穴。到木牌后往左，下落一层就沿左侧走，和蜗牛 Irma 交谈接下护送。
从第一处帐篷向上，在到顶之前转左。走到底下落，再往右清掉坩埚房的敌人。折回房外的坑向下，走左侧通道，再沿箭矢陷阱向右，操作右侧拉杆打开下方通路。
回到左侧，借箭矢平台向上，听 Irma 指路。继续攀爬通过箭矢和尖刺区，沿上层向左到第二处帐篷。帐篷左侧就是掘墓者战场。
击败掘墓者后继续向左，护送 Irma 到 Club Casket，参加 Squinton 的生日聚会。完成聚会剧情后领取金色羽毛。
en: Drop at the far right of Midnight Drench and head left. Use Slingshot and Climb to cross the platform and descend into Burial Vault. Go left past the wooden sign, drop once, then stay left and speak to Irma the snail to start the escort.

Climb above the first tent and turn left before reaching the top. Drop at the end and head right to clear the cauldron ambush. Backtrack to the pit, descend and take the left passage, then follow the arrow traps right and strike the lever to open the route below.

Return left and climb the arrow platforms until Irma gives directions. Continue through the arrows and spikes and stay on the upper route heading left to the second tent. The Gravedigger arena is just west of it.
After defeating the Gravedigger, continue left and escort Irma to Club Casket for Squinton’s birthday. Finish the party scene to claim the Golden Feather.
